name: xpost
description: Post to X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky and Pinterest through xpost. Every post waits for the person's approval. Bundles the hosted xpost MCP server (sign in on first use, no token) and the skill that teaches the workflow.

xpost.note: The hosted xpost MCP server (streamable HTTP). Authorizes via OAuth on first connection — the agent is prompted to sign in to xpost; no token or local install required.
